title: Play together
lanGuide: In Minecraft, open a world → Esc → Open to LAN → Start LAN World.
invalidPort: Enter a whole number from 1024 to 65535.
portNotOwned: This game is not listening on that port. Check its Open to LAN port.
startFirst: Start this game to host or join a group.
addressGuide: Minecraft → Multiplayer → Direct Connection. Paste this address.
loadFailed: Could not read this group. Refresh to try again.
actionFailed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
offline: Mesh is offline. Go online using the Mesh status above.
unavailable: Mesh is unavailable. Check the connection and try again.
alreadyActive: A group is already active. Refresh to view it.
otherGame: A group is active for another game.
notActive: This group has ended. Refresh to continue.
notHost: Only the host can change this group.
admissionClosed: The host is not accepting new members.
invalidInvite: This invitation is invalid or expired. Ask for a new one.
relayRequired: No connection service is available. Check Mesh and try again.
inviteExpired: Invitation expired. Create a new invitation.
joinDenied: Could not join this group. Ask the host to check access.
unknownMember: This member is no longer connected. Refresh the group.
busy: Another group action is in progress. Try again.
directRequired: No direct connection was established. Configure an approved private or community relay in Mesh connection settings.
